rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"Adds a [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] attribute, with an optional SurrogateType property, to MessagePack.Annotations. The source generator finds partial classes that carry the attribute, builds an ObjectSerializationInfo for the T in their single IMessagePackFormatter<T> interface, and writes the formatter body into the user's partial class instead of an internal sealed class. Without a surrogate, members of T are collected in contractless mode: public read-write instance properties and fields, keyed by name. With a surrogate, the surrogate's [Key] and [IgnoreMember] attributes set keys and membership. The change also adds four diagnostics (MsgPack019-022), a separate pipeline that reports them, execution tests against a new test library that has no MessagePack reference, and generator diagnostic tests.","why":"MP-2129 asks that a project referencing a library type with no MessagePack attributes, from a library that may not reference MessagePack at all, can get a source-generated formatter for that type in the referencing project.
